title: Appraisal Order Complexity Add-On and Its Booking
content:
**Appraisal Order — complexity add-on.** The complexity add-on is an Appraisal Order charge tied to the size and complexity of the property the report describes. It is booked as one charge and collected on the card or account the order's base fee was collected with; the charge stands on the order's gross-living-area surcharge line. Once booked, it stands in the order's fee history as a separate collected charge on that line.

## Booking the add-on

The booking is an agent-side action: the agent unlocks the tool `book_size_value_addon_5d867e2e` and then calls it. Each call collects one charge, dated today, on the order's gross-living-area surcharge line for the amount passed.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `appraisal_order_id` | Reference number of the Appraisal Order the add-on is booked on, as returned by the appraisal order lookup for the customer | Identifier |
| `loan_file_id` | Reference number of the Mortgage Loan File the Appraisal Order supports, as shown on that order and returned by the loan file lookup | Identifier |
| `addon_amount` | Amount of the add-on collected, in US dollars | Positive number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |
| `payment_method` | The card or account charged | One of the values below |

Values of `payment_method`:
- `debit_card` — the order's earlier charges were collected from the borrower's debit card;
- `credit_card` — they were collected from the borrower's credit card;
- `ach_debit` — they were debited from the borrower's bank account by ACH.

### Return

On success the tool returns a record with: `appraisal_fee_entry_id` (reference number of the new charge entry), `appraisal_order_id` (the order charged), `fee_component` (always `gla_surcharge`, the gross-living-area surcharge line), `amount` (US dollars, 2 decimal places, the amount collected), `entry_date` (today's date, year-month-day), `fee_balance` (the order's net appraisal charges paid after this entry, US dollars, 2 decimal places) and `status` (always `booked`). A status of booked means the charge now stands on the order: the order's fee history has gained one new charge entry on the gross-living-area surcharge line, and the order's net appraisal charges paid have risen by exactly the amount collected.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a call with an amount of 150.00 and `credit_card` returns a new entry on the `gla_surcharge` line for 150.00 dated today, with `fee_balance` 150.00 higher than before and status `booked`.
